ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly high-intensity (white) across approximately 70% of the surface area, contrasted with low-intensity (black) pigmentation concentrated at the trailing edges and distributed as mottling.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: High-contrast black mottling scattered across both lobes; dense black pigmentation along the trailing edge of the right lobe and the distal tip of the left lobe; a distinct vertical dark band originating from the median notch extending towards the peduncle.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped depression with a calculated pixel angle of approximately 72 degrees and a depth relative to the fluke span of approximately 12%.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations visible along both lobes; right lobe exhibits larger amplitude 'sawtooth' peaks (approx 5-10 pixels) compared to the left lobe.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curvature along the trailing edge of both lobes, transitioning into tapered, acute tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Numerous small, dark circular pixel clusters (mottling/spots) distributed across the white ventral surface, particularly dense in the mid-section of the left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Deep irregular indentation/trauma on the trailing edge of the right lobe, approximately midway between the notch and the tip, breaking the regular serration pattern.
other_distinctive_markers: A singular, prominent vertical dark stripe or linear pigment mark aligned with the central axis of the fluke near the peduncle junction.
